name: delegation-framework
description: Playbook, roles, and adversarial review machinery for a manager -> implementer -> skeptic operating model. Composes with the superpowers plugin (6.1.x, soft by-name dependency - see README): superpowers owns the loop, parallelism, and code-review mechanics; this plugin owns the residual (always-pair-a-skeptic discipline, review panels, lenses and rubric, reliability rules, commit gate).
